title: norite message --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite message list`, `send`, `edit`, `delete` and `history`.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. The shapes are the CLI's, re-declared from the instance's rather than passed through. Every nullable field is present and null, every list is [] rather than null, and every string an instance sent is exactly as sent, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

channel_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

author_id.description: A Snowflake ID as a decimal string, or null.

author.description: Who wrote it. Null with author_id null for a message with no author, and null with author_id set for one whose author's account was deleted.

content.description: Exactly as sent. Rendering it is the client's business (rule 9); here it is escaped only where a terminal would act on it.

reply_to_id.description: A Snowflake ID as a decimal string, or null.

tags.description: null when the credential cannot read tags; [] when the message has none.

author.description: The account that wrote a message, as its readers see it.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

username.description: Exactly as sent, escaped where a terminal would act on it.

display_name.description: Exactly as sent, escaped where a terminal would act on it.

messagePage.description: A page of a channel's messages, newest first.

next.description: The id to pass to --before for the next page, or null on the last page: a page shorter than --limit.

version.description: A message as it read before an edit.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

history.description: A message's earlier versions, newest first, and what it says now.

message_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

channel_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

author_id.description: A Snowflake ID as a decimal string, or null.

current_content.description: What it says now; null when deleted, or end-to-end encrypted.

e2e.description: End-to-end encrypted, so no version is readable (rule 13).

next.description: The id to pass to --before for older versions, or null.
